sloka: कुरु प्रसादं धर्मज्ञ कैकेय्या भरतस्य च ।सपुत्रां त्वां त्यजामीति यदुक्ता कैकयी त्वया ।। ६.१२२.२५ ।।
transliteration: kuru prasādaṁ dharmajña kaikeyyā bharatasya ca ।saputrāṁ tvāṁ tyajāmīti yaduktā kaikayī tvayā ।। 6.122.25 ।।

translations.english: Dasaratha having spoken to Rama, offered salutations with joined palms and said," You are righteous. Be gracious to Bharata and Kaikeyi also."
